reading: CoreSite Real Estate 1656 McCarthy, L.P. is a property-holding legal entity for CoreSite's Silicon Valley data center campus building at 1656 McCarthy Boulevard in Milpitas, California, confirmed through California business entity filings that also show a related general partner entity, CoreSite Real Estate 1656 McCarthy GP, L.L.C. Real estate investment trusts and their operating subsidiaries commonly hold individual properties under separate single-purpose LP or LLC entities for financing, liability, and tax structuring reasons, and this is standard practice for CoreSite, whose main operator record already appears in this registry as a subsidiary of American Tower Corporation with a Stonepeak minority stake. This record represents the same underlying operating business as that main CoreSite entry rather than an unrelated operator, and is preserved as a separate row per this registry's no-deletion policy, cross-linked to the canonical CoreSite record via duplicate_of so that the specific Milpitas property entity remains traceable in the registry's ownership structure.
